next.reason: 1985 SD: 'SD file-name-1 [RECORD {CONTAINS integer-1 CHARACTERS | IS VARYING ... | CONTAINS integer-4 TO integer-5 CHARACTERS}] [DATA {RECORD IS|RECORDS ARE} data-name-2 ...].' §2023:13.4.6.2 is 'SD file-name-1 [record-clause].' with the RECORD clause of §2023:13.18.43.2 (BYTES a synonym of CHARACTERS, §2023:13.18.43.3 SR2) and no DATA RECORDS clause anywhere in the standard, so an SD using DATA RECORDS is refused. CHANGED (stricter).
